{{Quote|Brentaal, Anaxes, the Ch'zimi'kho Conglomerate&mdash;everyone's singing the same song, Padmé. ''Of course we'll help&mdash;once there's an antidote''.|[[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], to [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]|<ref name="CWGSi">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]''</ref>}}
The '''Ch'zimi'kho Conglomerate''' was an organization that existed during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the war, [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd's]] use of a [[Damotite bioweapon|bioweapon]] made of the [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] material [[damotite]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] sowed fear throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The Conglomerate&mdash;along with the planets [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]] and [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]]&mdash;offered to support the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] effort to destroy the weapon, but out of fear of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] retribution, they would not help until an antidote to the [[Death/Legends|deadly]] weapon was found.<ref name="CWGSi" />
